about: Defects to plant in this kernel, one at a time, to measure whether the conformance kit rejects a kernel that has them. Each replaces one piece of source text. `model_case` names the planted defect in the formal models that it repeats, where there is one. tools/kit_adequacy.py applies them to a copy; the source here is never changed.
